example.title: Ira E. Lloyd Stock Farm, water tank silo

brief: Tall poured-concrete silo about 13 ft across and 48 ft high, formerly topped by a water tank: a flared concrete lip ring at the top, horizontal pour lines up the shaft, and a flat pilaster-like chute enclosure running full height on the front ending in an arched opening at the base. One small square window high up. Stands in a mown pasture with cedars behind. (Poured concrete; nearest vocabulary type is concrete_stave.)
